mapper.select: SELECT aat.tag_id AS tagId, mt.tag_name AS tagName, COUNT(*) AS articleCount FROM author_article aa INNER JOIN author_article_tag aat ON aa.id = aat.article_id INNER JOIN member_tag mt ON aat.tag_id = mt.id WHERE aa.author_id = #{authorId} AND aa.status = 1 AND aa.publish_time < NOW() and aa.order_deadline > NOW() AND aat.deleted = 0 AND mt.tag_type = 2 GROUP BY aat.tag_id, mt.tag_name

SELECT au.id AS authorId, au.nickname AS authorName, au.avatar_url AS avatarUrl , au.hit_rate AS hitRate, au.recent_articles AS recentArticles, au.recent_hits AS recentHits, au.consecutive_hits AS consecutiveHits, au.performance_show, aa.id AS articleId, aa.title AS title, aa.privilege_types AS privilegeTypes, aa.intro AS intro, aa.price AS price, aa.refund_type AS refundType, aa.order_deadline AS orderDeadline, aa.publish_time AS publishTime, aa.match_type AS matchType, aa.match_scheme AS matchScheme, aa.schedule_publish_status AS schedulePublishStatus, aa.schedule_publish_time AS schedulePublishTime, aa.visible_type AS visibleType, aa.visible_min_num AS visibleMinNum, aa.visible_min_amt AS visibleMinAmt, aa.visible_tag_ids AS visibleTagIds, aa.visible_user_ids AS visibleUserIds, aa.view_count AS viewCount FROM author_article aa INNER JOIN author_user au ON aa.author_id = au.id WHERE aa.status = 1 and aa.win_result=0 and aa.deleted=0 and aa.publish_time < NOW() and aa.order_deadline > NOW()
AND aa.author_id IN
#{id}
AND aa.match_type = #{matchType}
AND aa.match_type = 1 AND aa.match_count = 1
AND aa.match_type = 1 AND aa.match_count > 1
ORDER BY aa.match_start_time DESC
ORDER BY au.hit_rate DESC
ORDER BY aa.id DESC

SELECT au.id AS authorId, au.nickname AS authorName, au.avatar_url AS avatarUrl , au.hit_rate AS hitRate, au.recent_articles AS recentArticles, au.recent_hits AS recentHits, au.consecutive_hits AS consecutiveHits,
aa.id AS articleId, aa.title AS title, aa.privilege_types AS privilegeTypes, aa.price AS price, aa.match_start_time AS matchStartTime, aa.order_deadline AS orderDeadline, aa.publish_time AS publishTime, aa.match_type AS matchType, aa.match_scheme AS matchScheme, aa.refund_type AS refundType, CASE WHEN aa.schedule_content IS NOT NULL AND aa.schedule_content != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS schedulePublish, aa.visible_type AS visibleType, aa.visible_min_num AS visibleMinNum, aa.visible_min_amt AS visibleMinAmt, aa.visible_tag_ids AS visibleTagIds, aa.visible_user_ids AS visibleUserIds, aa.view_count AS viewCount FROM author_article aa INNER JOIN author_user au ON aa.author_id = au.id INNER JOIN author_article_match aam ON aa.id = aam.article_id and aam.author_id = au.id WHERE aa.status = 1 and aa.win_result=0 and aa.deleted=0 and aa.publish_time < NOW() and aa.order_deadline > NOW()
AND aam.match_id = #{matchId}
AND aam.match_id = -1
select distinct author_id from author_article where status = 1 and win_result = 0 and deleted = 0 and publish_time < NOW() and order_deadline > NOW()

SELECT CASE WHEN match_type = 1 AND match_count = 1 THEN 99 WHEN match_type = 1 AND match_count > 1 THEN 100 ELSE match_type END AS matchType, COUNT(*) AS articleCount FROM author_article WHERE win_result = 0 AND status = 1 AND deleted=0 AND publish_time < NOW() AND order_deadline > NOW()
AND author_id IN
#{id}
GROUP BY CASE WHEN match_type = 1 AND match_count = 1 THEN 99 WHEN match_type = 1 AND match_count > 1 THEN 100 ELSE match_type END

SELECT a.id, a.author_id, a.win_result FROM author_article a WHERE a.win_result > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM author_article_match m WHERE m.article_id = a.id AND m.class_id = #{classId}) order by a.id desc;
mapper.update: UPDATE author_user au LEFT JOIN ( SELECT author_id, COUNT (*) AS cnt FROM author_article WHERE status = 1 AND win_result = 0 AND publish_time < NOW() AND order_deadline > NOW() AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY author_id ) stat ON au.id = stat.author_id SET au.on_sale_num = COALESCE (stat.cnt, 0)
